title: Bill Robinson's tip on moving while singing
summary: Doing vaudeville in Cleveland, he gets dance steps and mugging advice from Bill Robinson that makes his number go over.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh yes. Now comes the time where we work together. Because what happened was, Dick Voynow, we did a little vaudeville around the area there with the band. That's when I started singing and we went in vaudeville.

Here's a little interesting thing, anecdote that might be interesting. We were playing in Cleveland in vaudeville, I've forgotten the name of the theater. And who's on the bill but Bo Jangles Robinson. (Bo Jangles?).
MRS. JOHNSTON: The dancer?
MR. MCPARTLAND: Yes.
MRS. JOHNSTON: The tap dancer.
MR. MCPARTLAND: It's terrible I can't even think of his first name. Robinson, that's frightening, that I can't think of it because what happened was, I was singing ....
MRS. JOHNSTON: Bill?
MR. MCPARTLAND: Bill Robinson, yes. Marvellous guy. And so after our first show I was singing a number 'Oh Boy, What a Girl' (SINGS) 'She's got this, she's got that, she's got this and part of that oh boy, what a gal'. And I used to just stand there and you know

move my shoulders and so forth. So after the first show Bill Robinson says, hey kid, come here. I'm going to put you into something he says. When you're doing that song out there, and there were no microphones in those days you know, this was a long time ago. He says, when you're doing that song out there, he says, do a little dance step while you're doing it, move around a little bit. He says, you see what happens.

And he showed me the steps, you know, just a little simple steps and I was very apt you know. I picked it up just like that the little steps that he showed me, they're nothing. And so I got out there the next show and did the number and man, it broke it up. Yes, Bill Robinson, Bo Jangles he gave me that little tip how to move around you know, do that little dance.
And you know I'd watch him with his dancing and then I got pretty cute you know. (LAUGHTER).
Went on up a little higher huh?
He was famous for dancing those steps, yes.

That's it, he showed me a few little things and I started giving a little mugging out there you know. And mugging the face a little bit and oh the number went over great from then on. So that was a nice little tip he gave me.
